purpose: OFAT (one-factor-at-a-time) ablation of the 3 interventions E2.2.2 combined at once. E2.2.2 added, simultaneously: (A) a GLOBAL_CONSISTENCY_RULE prompt sentence requiring one feature-type value across every concept sharing a feature name, (B) a COMPLETE_STATE_RULE prompt sentence requiring repaired_concepts to include every input concept, and (C) decision_schema.json's repaired_concepts.minItems=2 structural constraint -- reaching 20/20 (1.00) from E2.2.1's 3/20 (0.15), but leaving it impossible to tell which factor(s) were necessary or sufficient. This design isolates each factor into its own arm on top of the SAME vocab-exposure baseline shared by E2.2.1 and E2.2.2 (structural_composition vocabulary hint; constant infrastructure, not one of the 3 ablation factors): A_ONLY (vocab + Factor A only), B_ONLY (vocab + Factor B only), C_ONLY (vocab only, schema minItems=2 but no extra prompt rules). Diagnostic ablation design -- no single accept/reject Go/No-go, unlike E2.2.1/E2.2.2.
source: dir1_directed fixture and oracle copied verbatim from experiments/2026-07-24_e2.2.2_directed_pc_invariant_fix/fixture.json (frozen E2.2.2 design, commit 559f61f), unmodified back through experiments/2026-07-24_e2.2.1_directed_pc_vocabulary_fix/fixture.json and experiments/2026-07-23_isa_certificate_structure_bvsc/fixture.json (frozen E2.2 design, commit 49f030b). Not modified except arms/replicates: 1 arm ['FULL']x20 -> 3 arms ['A_ONLY','B_ONLY','C_ONLY']x20 each (N=60 total).
